transcript.content: Hello, I'm Dr. Smith. It's nice to meet you; could you tell me what brings you in to see me today?

Nice to meet you, Dr. Smith. Well, I guess I came in because... for a long time now, I've just had this heavy, low feeling sitting on me most days. 

I mean, I still get through my driving routes, and I do my volunteer shifts, but it just feels like I'm going through the motions. Like I'm not really in my own life anymore, just kind of... existing. So, I figured it was time to come talk to somebody about it.
How long have you been feeling this way?
It's been... about three years now. Ever since my father passed away, really.

In the three years since your father passed away, have you had any periods lasting at least two months where you felt like your old self again, or has this low mood been present almost every single day?

No, I haven't really had any breaks like that. It's just... it's been pretty much every day. I mean, maybe a day or two here and there where I'm distracted, but definitely not two whole months of feeling like my old self. The heavy feeling is just always there in the background.
